Enumerates .zqk/object_drafts and deletes draft-plane YAML only.

Never deletes CAS-backed objects (skipped as cas_backed).

Default is dry-run; pass --all (or --max with filters) to apply deletes.

Applying deletes (--dry-run=false) requires RBAC permission
delete:object_draft_plane

on the authenticated ACC (role-granted; parallel to delete:core). Dry-run stays
open.

Unbound system context is refused — authenticate via ZQK_API_KEY / ACC
seating.

  Dry-run (default): show what would be deleted
  zqk object draft sweep --dry-run --all
  Apply deletes when ACC role grants delete:object_draft_plane
  zqk object draft sweep --kind backlog_item --all --dry-run=false
  Apply with optional seat correlation
  zqk object draft sweep --agent-id cursor-composer --id-prefix BLI- --max 10 --dry-run=false

Usage:
  zqk object draft sweep [flags]

Flags:
      --agent-id string     Optional seat id for audit/correlation only; authorization is RBAC on the authenticated account
      --all                 Required to apply deletes across the matched set (fail closed without this or --max+filters)
      --dry-run             List matching drafts without deleting (default true)
      --force               Force sweep in local developer workspaces without ACC account
  -f, --format string       Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --id-prefix string    Only ids with this prefix
      --kind string         Limit to one object kind directory under object_drafts
      --max int             Optional cap on deletions / would-delete listings
      --older-than string   Only drafts whose file mtime is older than this duration (e.g. 24h, 168h)
  -o, --output string       Write output to file
  -q, --quiet               Suppress non-essential output
      --status string       Only drafts whose YAML status equals this value
      --timeout duration    Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose             Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
